bloodcontracts.help.place.title: Placing a bounty
bloodcontracts.help.place.body: Put one or more items in: they leave your inventory and go into escrow. The server never creates anything, every reward comes from a player. One bounty per target and sponsor, at most %s active bounties.
bloodcontracts.help.types.title: Public or private
bloodcontracts.help.types.body: Public: anyone can collect it except the sponsor and the target. Private: only the chosen hunters (at most %s) can, and their list stays secret.
bloodcontracts.help.types.widen: A bounty can only be widened: add hunters or make it public. To narrow it, cancel it and place a new one.
bloodcontracts.help.cancel.title: Cancelling with notice
bloodcontracts.help.cancel.body: Cancelling starts a %s notice: the bounty stays posted and collectable, with a countdown. Then the item goes back to the sponsor, who can also resume the bounty during the notice.
bloodcontracts.help.kills.title: Who gets the credit?
bloodcontracts.help.kills.body: The player who lands the fatal blow: sword, arrow, TNT they lit, a cannon they just operated.
bloodcontracts.help.kills.pets: A tamed pet credits its owner.
bloodcontracts.help.kills.environment: The void, a fall or lava count if the hunter hit the target within the %s seconds before. A death with no player involved does not count.
bloodcontracts.help.hearts.title: Hearts
bloodcontracts.help.hearts.body: A death that pays a bounty costs the target %s heart, gained by the sponsor. Floor: at most %s hearts lost. Ceiling: at most %s hearts gained.
bloodcontracts.help.hearts.regen: Hearts come back half a heart every %s of play, or every %s offline: playing brings them back faster.
bloodcontracts.help.hearts.permanent: On this server, lost hearts never come back.
bloodcontracts.help.immunity.title: Immunity
bloodcontracts.help.immunity.body: After a death that pays a bounty, the target is immune for %s of real time: no bounty can be collected on them. Logging out wastes it.
bloodcontracts.help.claim.title: Getting your items
bloodcontracts.help.claim.body: Rewards you won and refunded items wait for you in the "To claim" tab.
